arguments.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='docs/threads.md'
s=open(p).read()
a='''| `Snapshot` | The stash commit |
| `Thread-Tip` | The commit of `refs/pi/threads/<number>` when pi-action saved the snapshot |
| `Thread-Entry` | The newest entry of the conversation when pi-action saved the snapshot |
| `Branch` | The branch, or `(detached)` |
| `Head` | The commit that `HEAD` pointed to |
| `Skipped` |'''
assert a in s
s=s.replace(a,'''| `Snapshot` | The stash commit |
| `Skipped` |''')
s=s.replace('The wrapper commit has these trailers:','The branch and the commit that `HEAD` pointed to are in the stash commit, as `git stash` records them: its first parent is `HEAD`, and its subject is `WIP on <branch>: ...`. The wrapper commit has these trailers:')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
grep -n "Thread-Tip\|Thread-Entry" -r . --include=*.md --exclude-dir=node_modules; npx oxfmt >/dev/null; npm run check >/tmp/c.log 2>&1; echo $?; grep -E "error|×|FAIL" /tmp/c.log | head; git diff --shortstat
